svg.text: Underlined attributes form primary keys. Arrows point from foreign keys to the referenced keys.
Composite keys: INVENTORY(product_id, warehouse_id); PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEMS(order_id, product_id).
LOW_STOCK_ALERTS(product_id, warehouse_id) is ONE composite foreign key to INVENTORY, and the pair is UNIQUE.
ANOMALY_LOGS.movement_id is UNIQUE. Other uniqueness and validation constraints are defined in 01_schema.sql.
